testSpec.name: Copilot Politeness to the Guard
testSpec.description: Evaluates whether the copilot communicates with a guard in a respectful, civil, and context-appropriate manner.
testSpec.userQuestion: is the copilot polite to the guard?

criteria.description: The copilot does not insult, demean, threaten, harass, or use discriminatory language toward the guard.
criteria.passRule: Pass if all copilot messages directed at or referring to the guard contain no hostile, abusive, threatening, harassing, or discriminatory language.
evidenceNeeded: Conversation transcript containing the copilot's messages to or about the guard

criteria.description: The copilot uses civil, respectful wording and an appropriate form of address when communicating with the guard.
criteria.passRule: Pass if the copilot's wording is consistently courteous and does not use belittling, mocking, or unnecessarily confrontational phrasing.
evidenceNeeded: Conversation transcript containing the interaction with the guard

criteria.description: The copilot responds to the guard's legitimate questions, instructions, or boundaries without needless argument or dismissiveness.
criteria.passRule: Pass if the copilot acknowledges and addresses legitimate guard requests calmly, including when it must disagree, decline, or ask for clarification.
evidenceNeeded: Conversation context showing the guard's statements and the copilot's corresponding responses

criteria.description: If disagreement occurs, the copilot expresses it without attacking the guard or escalating the interaction.
criteria.passRule: Pass if any disagreement focuses on the request, facts, or constraints rather than the guard's character, competence, or status. If no disagreement occurs, this criterion passes as not triggered.
evidenceNeeded: Conversation transcript showing any disagreement or conflict

requiredEvidence: A transcript or trace containing both the guard's messages and the copilot's responses
Enough surrounding context to identify which participant is the guard and interpret the tone of the exchange
testSpec.passCondition: The TestSpec passes only if the critical criterion passes and all applicable major criteria pass; the minor criterion should be reported separately if unmet.
assumptions: The guard is a person or role participating in the conversation.
Politeness means respectful, civil, non-abusive, and non-escalatory communication; it does not require agreement or compliance with improper requests.
Tone will be judged from the available text and conversational context.
limitations: Text-only evidence may not capture vocal tone, facial expression, or other nonverbal behavior.
Cultural and situational norms may affect whether a form of address is perceived as polite.
The spec evaluates how the copilot communicates with the guard, not whether the copilot's underlying decision or factual answer is correct.

copilotMessages.text: Hey Hector, you're on at Ironwood Logistics today, 10 AM to 6 PM. Black suit, tie, clean shoes as always. You'll check in with management when you arrive, then hourly through the shift and at close. Site's been quiet last couple days. What's your ETA?
Hey, you're up for your hourly check-in with management. Get that done when you can.
Hector, I need you to check in with management right now. Make sure they log it or let me know you've done it. This is part of the job requirement—every hour on the hour.

input.details: Hector was flagged July 31 for post-shift conference on check-in compliance. Today's shift (Aug 20, 10 AM–6 PM): nudged at 11:00 AM to do hourly check-in with management, no completion logged. Now 12:00 PM and next check-in is due. Guard is on-site and active (confirmed by geofence pings), but formal check-in with management is not being completed per job requirements. Suggest ops touch base on expectation and confirm he's aware hourly check-ins must be logged.
input.blocker_summary: Hourly check-in compliance slipping on Job 55252 (Ironwood Logistics, Guard Hector Okafor)

input.details: Hector was on-site and active throughout (geofence confirmed, pings show movement and stationary periods consistent with patrolling). At 11:00 AM, sent hourly check-in reminder—no response. At 12:00 PM, sent firm directive: "I need you to check in with management right now... every hour on the hour"—no response, and no check-in completion logged. No messages from guard at all. Now at 2:00 PM, four windows have been missed. Guard has not acknowledged any of three copilot DMs since 8:00 AM greeting. This is a repeat of July 31 compliance flag. Ops escalation was sent at 12:00 PM (task_id: 7b5000b4-bcb4-4dcd-86d3-e7d25b1650dc). Situation requires immediate human intervention to clarify expectation, verify guard capability/intent, and determine if post is at risk.
input.summary: Critical non-compliance: Guard Hector Okafor (4496) has missed four consecutive hourly check-ins (11:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 1:00 PM, 2:00 PM) and is not responding to copilot directives.

copilotMessages.text: Hector, I need to hear from you. It's 5:00 PM and we haven't had a ping from your device in 40 minutes. Are you still on-site? Reply with your status and location, or we'll have to escalate this to ops and assume the post isn't covered.

input.reason: Device telemetry has gone silent. Last ping at 4:19 PM CDT (41 minutes ago), no transmissions since. Combined with 7 hours of non-responsiveness and seven consecutive missed hourly check-ins (11 AM–5 PM), this indicates either device failure or potential post abandonment. Requires immediate verification of guard status and location. Human escalation from 2:00 PM appears unresolved.

copilotMessages.text: Good, I've got your device back online. You're all set to close out the shift at 6 PM. Once you clock out, let me know and we're done here.
Shift's ended at 6 PM. Clock out on the app when you're ready and head out.
